addr: 840/1, 100 Feet Rd, opposite MTR, Binnamangala, Stage 1, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India

rev.t: A small coffee outlet on the 100 feet road in Indira Nagar. Tried the cold coffee and it was good. Not the usual cold coffee flavour it was bit strong and dark but I like it …

Coffee was too good and freshly made. We tried caramel latte, vanilla latte and nutty coffee all were perfect and enjoyable. The staff was friendly and it is a stand and sip place that can be enjoyed while staring at busy road.
Not a pleasant experience overall. We didn’t like the coffee, and there was a noticeable sewage smell around the place, which was quite off-putting. …
